title: URL Cleaner
summary: Strips tracking parameters such as utm_*, fbclid, gclid and igshid from the address bar and from URLs you copy, so the links you paste do not carry an audience profile with them.

features.title: Cleans the address bar on load
features.body: Rewrites the current URL with history.replaceState, so the tracking parameters disappear without a reload and without losing the page state.

features.title: Cleans copied links
features.body: Hooks copy and cut in the capture phase, so a selected URL is rewritten before the page's own clipboard handler sees it.

features.title: Covers the usual offenders
features.body: Drops utm_*, fbclid, gclid, dclid, msclkid, twclid, mc_eid, igshid, li_fat_id, HubSpot and Marketo parameters, and similar campaign tags.

options.name: Clean address bar
options.description: Rewrite the current tab's URL when tracking parameters are present.

options.name: Clean copied URLs
options.description: Rewrite a selected URL on copy or cut before it reaches the clipboard.

notes: Only parameters known to be tracking tags are removed. Functional parameters such as page ids, search terms and share tokens are left alone.
Pages that read the URL before this script runs may have already seen the original parameters; the address bar itself is still cleaned.
